parsed.evidence_quote: samples were combined at a 1:1 ratio of peptides based on normalization factors, dried, and fractionated using High pH Reversed-Phase Peptide Fractionation kit (Pierce). Six fractions were dried, desalted, and analyzed by liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS).
HEK293T, HCT116 cells (ATCC) and HeLa/FAP-EGFR were maintained with DMEM
1,886 proteins were quantified in all three independent experiments
we generated human colon carcinoma HCT116 and human embryonic kidney HEK293T cell lines that stably express EGFR fused at the C terminus with APEX2
1μL of LysC stock solution (2 mg/mL, Wako) was added into each sample... Trypsin stock (Promega #V51113) 1:200 (vol/vol) was then added for further digestion overnight
100 μg of each TMT 10plex (or TMT 9/11plex) reagent were used for labeling.
Samples were reduced with 5 mM TCEP, alkylated with 10 mM iodoacetamide
fractionated using High pH Reversed-Phase Peptide Fractionation kit (Pierce)

TMT tags on lysine residues and peptide N termini (+229.163 Da) and carbamidomethylation of cysteine residues (+57.021 Da) were set as static modifications. Oxidation of methionine residues (+15.995 Da) was set as a variable modification.
Six fractions were dried, desalted, and analyzed by liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS).
After 1 min of H2O2 treatment, cells were washed with ice-cold quenching solution
All experimental treatments were carried out in DMEM supplemented with 0.1% BSA at 37°C (“binding medium”) unless stated otherwise.
After cell lysis and streptavidin-biotin pull-down, precipitated biotinylated proteins are digested by LysC/trypsin
samples were combined at a 1:1 ratio of peptides based on normalization factors, dried, and fractionated using High pH Reversed-Phase Peptide Fractionation kit (Pierce).
